name: Pakaitos, the new Capital
description: The Kepesh capital is a splendid city erected upon golden sands, encircled by towering sandstone walls glistening under the desert sun. The city’s layout features broad, orderly streets leading to an expansive plaza, with the central pyramids and temples dedicated to Ba-Ka, containing extensive libraries, mystical laboratories, and sacred vaults. The city’s design, encompassing the walls, streets, and temples, forms a vast magical circle that channels Ba-Ka’s divine grace, bestowing potent mystical defenses. The outer walls resist most magic, the water remains perpetually pure, and spellcasters recover their magical energies much quicker. Despite the blistering heat and sporadic sandstorms, the mystical barrier wards off the sand and also maintains Pakaitos’ relative comfort, hot for those non-accustomed but colder than the desert around. Beneath the city lie chambers where extraplanar elementals of diverse kinds are bound by magic. Wizards and clerics harness these elementals to forge magic items and conduct grandiose rituals. The urban structure reflects its rigid societal hierarchy, with concentric circles divided by walls, each representing a different caste. The bustling outer rings teem with markets offering exotic spices, magic items, and the unique handicrafts of Kepesh’s artisans, including elaborate jewelry and distinctively fashioned ceramics. Nonetheless, Pakaitos faces a threat from the Cult of the Shadow Wing. The resurgence of Ba-Ka worship worries the Ungods, prompting them to dispatch servants to undermine the Kepesh capital. As the city welcomes numerous refugees annually, the Cult has infiltrated occult cells within. The Hidden Cult operates among the Servants Caste, the Purple Witches blend in with the Wizards Caste, the Shadow Lords tempt several Ba-Ka’s clerics with greater power, and the Spawners of Droggath use the barbarian tribes against Kepesh’s farmlands and traders. The Pharaoh personally confronts these foes or delegates his most loyal servants to combat them, but the Cult’s assaults are unyielding. Lacking sufficient capable adherents to counter all threats, the Lich offers substantial rewards in gold or magic items to adventurers and mercenaries from distant lands willing to help suppress the Cult.
